76	    def _batch_size(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe) -> str:
77	        """Per-recipe batch size (``recipes/benchmarks/<task>.yaml``) or the global."""
78	        return str(recipe.batch_size if recipe.batch_size is not None else self.batch_size)
79	
80	    def group_key(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe) -> tuple:
81	        """Params that must match for two tasks to share one ``lm_eval`` call."""
82	        gen = self._is_generative(recipe)
83	        fewshot_mt = (
84	            self.fewshot_as_multiturn
85	            if self.fewshot_as_multiturn is not None
86	            else recipe.fewshot_as_multiturn or gen
87	        )
88	        gk = self.gen_kwargs or recipe.gen_kwargs or ({"max_gen_toks": self.gen_max_toks} if gen else {})
89	        return (gen, bool(fewshot_mt), recipe.num_fewshot, self._batch_size(recipe),
90	                tuple(sorted(gk.items())))
91	
92	    def build_command(
93	        self, recipes: BenchmarkRecipe | list[BenchmarkRecipe], model: str, backend, out_dir: Path
94	    ) -> list[str]:
95	        if isinstance(recipes, BenchmarkRecipe):
96	            recipes = [recipes]
97	        lead = recipes[0]
98	        generative = self._is_generative(lead)
99	        model_args = backend.build_model_args(
100	            model, num_gpus=self.num_gpus, gen_max_toks=self.gen_max_toks,
101	            generative=generative, extra_args=self.model_args,
102	        )
103	        tasks = ",".join(r.task_name() for r in recipes)
104	        cmd = [
105	            "lm_eval",
106	            "--model", backend.lm_eval_model_flag,
107	            "--model_args", model_args,
108	            "--tasks", tasks,
109	            "--batch_size", self._batch_size(lead),
110	            "--output_path", str(out_dir),
111	            "--log_samples",
112	            "--seed", str(self.seed),
113	        ]
114	        if lead.num_fewshot is not None:
115	            cmd += ["--num_fewshot", str(lead.num_fewshot)]
116	        if generative:
117	            fewshot_mt = (
118	                self.fewshot_as_multiturn
119	                if self.fewshot_as_multiturn is not None
120	                else lead.fewshot_as_multiturn or True
121	            )
122	            cmd += ["--apply_chat_template"]
123	            if fewshot_mt:
124	                cmd += ["--fewshot_as_multiturn"]
125	            if backend.lm_eval_model_flag == "hf":
126	                gen = self.gen_kwargs or lead.gen_kwargs or {"max_gen_toks": self.gen_max_toks}
127	                cmd += ["--gen_kwargs", ",".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in gen.items())]
128	        if self.limit is not None:
129	            cmd += ["--limit", str(self.limit)]
130	        return cmd
131	
132	    def run(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe, model: str, backend, out_dir: Path) -> BenchmarkResult:
133	        return self.run_group([recipe], model, backend, out_dir)[0]
134	
135	    def run_group(
136	        self, recipes: list[BenchmarkRecipe], model: str, backend, out_dir: Path
137	    ) -> list[BenchmarkResult]:
138	        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
139	        cmd = self.build_command(recipes, model, backend, out_dir)
140	        _log.info("[CMD] %s", " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd))
141	        env_extra = backend.env_overrides()
142	        if not self.available():
143	            raise AqaError(
144	                "lm_eval is not installed; install with `pip install autoquant-agent[lm-eval]`"
145	            )
146	        import os
147	
148	        env = os.environ | env_extra
149	        tag = recipes[0].name if len(recipes) == 1 else "+".join(r.name for r in recipes)
150	        log_path = out_dir / f"{tag}.eval.log"
151	        from ...proc import stream_subprocess
152	
153	        rc = stream_subprocess(cmd, log_path, env=env)
154	        if rc != 0:
155	            raise AqaError(
156	                f"lm_eval failed for {tag} (rc={rc}); see {log_path}"
157	                + _log_tail(log_path)
158	            )
159	        data = self._load_results(out_dir)
160	        cmd_str = shlex.join(cmd)
161	        results = [self._result_for(recipe, data) for recipe in recipes]
162	        for r in results:
163	            r.command = cmd_str
164	        return results
165	
166	    def parse_results(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe, out_dir: Path) -> BenchmarkResult:
167	        return self._result_for(recipe, self._load_results(out_dir))
168	
169	    def _load_results(self, out_dir: Path) -> dict:
170	        results_files = sorted(out_dir.rglob("results*.json"))
171	        if not results_files:
172	            raise AqaError(f"no lm_eval results json found under {out_dir}")
173	        return json.loads(results_files[-1].read_text())
174	
175	    def _result_for(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe, data: dict) -> BenchmarkResult:
176	        task_results = data.get("results", {})
177	        task_data = task_results.get(recipe.task_name()) or next(iter(task_results.values()), {})
178	        score, metric = _extract_metric(task_data, recipe)
179	        n = int(data.get("n-samples", {}).get(recipe.task_name(), {}).get("effective", 0) or 0)
180	        return BenchmarkResult(
181	            name=recipe.name, score=score, metric=metric, num_samples=n, raw=task_data
182	        )
183	
184	
185	def _extract_metric(task_data: dict, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe) -> tuple[float, str]:
186	    """Pick the primary accuracy-like metric from an lm_eval task result block."""
187	    prefer = list(recipe.scoring.prefer)
188	    if recipe.scoring.metric:
189	        prefer = [recipe.scoring.metric] + prefer
190	    # exact_match variants first (generative), then acc_norm, then acc.
191	    default_order = [
192	        "exact_match,strict-match", "exact_match,flexible-extract", "exact_match",
193	        "acc_norm,none", "acc_norm", "acc,none", "acc",
194	    ]
195	    for key in prefer + default_order:
196	        if key in task_data and isinstance(task_data[key], (int, float)):
197	            return float(task_data[key]), key
198	    # last resort: first numeric non-stderr metric.
199	    for key, val in task_data.items():
200	        if isinstance(val, (int, float)) and "stderr" not in key and "alias" not in key:
201	            return float(val), key
202	    return 0.0, "unknown"

1	"""Diffusion text-to-image harness: vllm-omni generation + CLIP score.
2	
3	Reads a prompt set from the recipe's ``dataset`` (a HF datasets uri such as
4	``sayakpaul/drawbench``, or a local ``.jsonl``/``.csv`` with a prompt column),
5	generates one image per prompt through vllm-omni's ``Omni`` API, then scores
6	each image against its prompt with a CLIP model (image-text cosine x 100, i.e.
7	CLIP's own ``logits_per_image`` scale -- higher is better, gate-compatible).
8	
9	Generation and scoring are deliberately two phases: the ``Omni`` instance (the
10	DiT is expensive to load and holds the GPU) is released before the CLIP scorer
11	loads.  Benchmarks sharing generation parameters are grouped by the runner and
12	served by a single ``Omni`` load via :meth:`DiffusionHarness.run_group`.
13	
14	Heavy dependencies (``vllm_omni``, ``torch``, ``transformers``, ``datasets``,
15	``PIL``) are imported lazily inside methods so the module stays importable on
16	machines without a GPU stack.
17	"""
18

20	
21	import csv
22	import importlib.util
23	import json
24	from pathlib import Path
25	from typing import Any

51	        self.guidance_scale = guidance_scale

53	        self.width = width

55	        self.scorer_model = scorer_model

65	        """Params that must match for recipes to share one ``Omni`` load."""

68	            self.guidance_scale,

75	    # ── prompt set ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
76	    def _load_prompts(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe) -> list[str]:
77	        if not recipe.dataset:
78	            raise AqaError(
79	                f"diffusion recipe {recipe.name} needs a `dataset` "
80	                "(HF datasets uri or a local .jsonl/.csv file)"
81	            )
82	        field = recipe.prompt_field or self.prompt_field
83	        source = recipe.dataset
84	        path = Path(source)
85	        if path.suffix == ".jsonl" and path.exists():
86	            rows = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
87	        elif path.suffix == ".csv" and path.exists():
88	            with path.open(newline="") as fh:
89	                rows = list(csv.DictReader(fh))

93	            except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - optional heavy dep
94	                raise AqaError(
95	                    "diffusion harness needs `datasets` for HF prompt sets: pip install datasets"
96	                ) from exc
97	            rows = list(load_dataset(source, split=self.dataset_split))
98	        prompts = [str(row[field]) for row in rows if row.get(field)]
99	        if self.limit is not None:
100	            prompts = prompts[: self.limit]
101	        if not prompts:

103	                f"diffusion recipe {recipe.name}: no prompts found in {source!r} "
104	                f"(field {field!r}, split {self.dataset_split!r})"

106	        return prompts

108	    # ── generation (vllm-omni) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
109	    def _load_omni(self, model: str):

111	            from vllm_omni.entrypoints.omni import Omni
112	        except ImportError as exc:

114	                "vllm-omni is not installed; install it to use the diffusion harness"
115	            ) from exc
116	        return Omni(model=model, mode="text-to-image")

118	    def _release_omni(self, omni) -> None:
119	        """Free the DiT / VRAM held by an ``Omni`` instance (best-effort)."""
120	        try:
121	            close = getattr(omni, "close", None)
122	            if callable(close):
123	                close()
124	        finally:
125	            try:
126	                import torch
127	
128	                if torch.cuda.is_available():
129	                    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
130	            except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - CPU-only box
131	                pass
132	
133	    def _sampling_params_list(self, omni, seed: int) -> list:
134	        """Build the per-stage sampling params for one generation call.
135	
136	        Mirrors ``examples/offline_inference/text_to_image/text_to_image.py``:
137	        single-stage models (FLUX.1-dev) take our params directly; for
138	        multi-stage pipelines our diffusion params replace the diffusion slot
139	        of the engine's ``default_sampling_params_list``.
140	        """
141	        from vllm_omni.inputs.data import OmniDiffusionSamplingParams
142	
143	        params = OmniDiffusionSamplingParams(
144	            height=self.height,
145	            width=self.width,
146	            seed=seed,
147	            guidance_scale=self.guidance_scale,
148	            num_inference_steps=self.num_inference_steps,
149	            num_outputs_per_prompt=1,
150	        )
151	        defaults = list(getattr(omni, "default_sampling_params_list", None) or [])
152	        if not defaults:
153	            return [params]
154	        replaced = False
155	        resolved = []
156	        for default in defaults:
157	            if isinstance(default, OmniDiffusionSamplingParams):
158	                resolved.append(params)
159	                replaced = True
160	            else:
161	                resolved.append(default)
162	        if not replaced and len(resolved) == 1:
163	            resolved = [params]
164	        return resolved
165	
166	    @staticmethod
167	    def _extract_image(outputs) -> Any:
168	        """Pull the first PIL image out of ``omni.generate()`` outputs."""
169	        images = None
170	        for output in outputs or []:
171	            images = getattr(output, "images", None)
172	            if images:

174	        if not images:

178	            import numpy as np

180	
181	            image = numpy_to_pil(np.asarray(image))[0]
182	        return image

184	    def _generate_images(self, omni, prompts: list[str], images_dir: Path) -> list[dict]:
185	        """Generate one PNG per prompt into ``images_dir`` + ``metadata.csv``.
186	
187	        Rows are appended and flushed per prompt, and existing rows are skipped,
188	        so an interrupted run resumes where it left off.
189	        """
190	        images_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
191	        meta_path = images_dir / "metadata.csv"
192	        done: dict[int, dict] = {}
193	        if meta_path.exists():
194	            with meta_path.open(newline="") as fh:
195	                for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
196	                    done[int(row["idx"])] = row
197	
198	        with meta_path.open("a", newline="") as fh:
199	            writer = csv.writer(fh)
200	            if not done:
201	                writer.writerow(["idx", "prompt", "image_path", "seed"])
202	                fh.flush()
203	            for idx, prompt in enumerate(prompts):
204	                if idx in done:
205	                    continue
206	                seed = self.seed + idx  # per-prompt deterministic seed
207	                image_path = images_dir / f"{idx:04d}.png"
208	                request = {"prompt": prompt, "modalities": ["image"]}
209	                try:
210	                    outputs = omni.generate(
211	                        request, sampling_params_list=self._sampling_params_list(omni, seed)
212	                    )
213	                    self._extract_image(outputs).save(image_path)
214	                except AqaError:
215	                    raise
216	                except Exception as exc:
217	                    raise AqaError(
218	                        f"vllm-omni generation failed for prompt {idx} ({prompt[:60]!r}): {exc}"
219	                    ) from exc
220	                row = {
221	                    "idx": str(idx),
222	                    "prompt": prompt,
223	                    "image_path": str(image_path),
224	                    "seed": str(seed),
225	                }
226	                writer.writerow([row["idx"], row["prompt"], row["image_path"], row["seed"]])
227	                fh.flush()
228	                done[idx] = row
229	                _log.info("  generated %s (seed=%d)", image_path, seed)
230	        return [done[idx] for idx in sorted(done)]
231	
232	    # ── scoring (CLIP) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
233	    def _score_images(self, rows: list[dict]) -> list[float]:
234	        """CLIP image-text cosine x 100 per row (CLIP's logits_per_image scale)."""
235	        import torch
236	        from PIL import Image
237	        from transformers import CLIPModel, CLIPProcessor
238	
239	        device = self.scorer_device
240	        if device == "auto":
241	            device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
242	        model = CLIPModel.from_pretrained(self.scorer_model).to(device)
243	        processor = CLIPProcessor.from_pretrained(self.scorer_model)
244	        scores: list[float] = []
245	        for row in rows:
246	            image = Image.open(row["image_path"])
247	            inputs = processor(
248	                text=[row["prompt"]], images=[image], return_tensors="pt", padding=True
249	            ).to(device)
250	            with torch.no_grad():
251	                outputs = model(**inputs)
252	            # logits_per_image is cosine similarity scaled by CLIP's logit
253	            # scale (100), i.e. the conventional CLIP score x 100.
254	            scores.append(float(outputs.logits_per_image[0, 0]))
255	        return scores
256	
257	    # ── Harness contract ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
258	    def _command_str(self, model: str) -> str:
259	        # No CLI invocation exists (the harness drives the Omni API in-process);
260	        # record the exact generation+scoring setup as the reproducibility string.
261	        return (
262	            f"vllm_omni Omni(model={model!r}, mode='text-to-image') "
263	            f"generate(num_inference_steps={self.num_inference_steps}, "
264	            f"guidance_scale={self.guidance_scale}, size={self.width}x{self.height}, "
265	            f"seed={self.seed}) + clip_score({self.scorer_model})"
266	        )
267	
268	    def _result_for(
269	        self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe, model: str, recipe_dir: Path, rows: list[dict]
270	    ) -> BenchmarkResult:
271	        scores = self._score_images(rows)
272	        return BenchmarkResult(
273	            name=recipe.name,
274	            score=sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0.0,
275	            metric="clip_score",
276	            num_samples=len(scores),
277	            per_sample=scores,
278	            raw={
279	                "metadata": str(recipe_dir / "images" / "metadata.csv"),
280	                "scorer_model": self.scorer_model,
281	            },
282	            command=self._command_str(model),
283	        )
284	
285	    def run(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe, model: str, backend, out_dir: Path) -> BenchmarkResult:
286	        prompts = self._load_prompts(recipe)
287	        omni = self._load_omni(model)
288	        try:
289	            rows = self._generate_images(omni, prompts, out_dir / "images")
290	        finally:
291	            self._release_omni(omni)
292	        return self._result_for(recipe, model, out_dir, rows)
293	
294	    def run_group(
295	        self, recipes: list[BenchmarkRecipe], model: str, backend, out_dir: Path
296	    ) -> list[BenchmarkResult]:
297	        """Evaluate several recipes on one shared ``Omni`` load (DiT load is expensive)."""
298	        omni = self._load_omni(model)
299	        try:
300	            generated = []
301	            for recipe in recipes:
302	                prompts = self._load_prompts(recipe)
303	                recipe_dir = out_dir / recipe.name
304	                rows = self._generate_images(omni, prompts, recipe_dir / "images")
305	                generated.append((recipe, recipe_dir, rows))
306	        finally:
307	            self._release_omni(omni)
308	        return [
309	            self._result_for(recipe, model, recipe_dir, rows)
310	            for recipe, recipe_dir, rows in generated
311	        ]

1	"""Native evaluation harness (migrated from NeMo Evaluator, Apache-2.0).
2	
3	The core loop -- render prompt -> generate -> score with the scorer library -- is
4	kept pure and testable via :meth:`NativeHarness.evaluate_samples` (inject a
5	``generate_fn``).  :meth:`run` wires a real generation function from the backend
6	(HF transformers) and requires model weights + torch to actually execute.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import importlib
12	import importlib.util
13	from collections.abc import Callable
14	from pathlib import Path
15	from typing import Any
16	
17	from ...logging_util import AqaError, get_logger
18	from ..dataset import load_samples, render_prompt
19	from ..registry import BenchmarkRecipe, BenchmarkResult
20	from ..scoring import BUILTIN_SCORERS, ScorerInput, build_judge_scorer
21	
22	_log = get_logger("harness.native")
23	
24	GenerateFn = Callable[[str], str]
25	
26	
27	def resolve_scorer(
28	    spec_name: str, spec: Any = None,
29	) -> Callable[[ScorerInput], dict[str, Any]]:
30	    """Resolve a scorer by builtin name or ``module.py:func`` escape hatch.
31	
32	    ``spec`` is the recipe's :class:`ScoringSpec`; it lets configurable scorers
33	    (currently ``llm_judge``) read their config (``spec.judge``) at build time.
34	    """
35	    if spec_name == "llm_judge":
36	        judge = getattr(spec, "judge", None) if spec is not None else None
37	        return build_judge_scorer(judge)
38	    if spec_name == "code_exec":
39	        from ..code_exec import build_code_exec_scorer
40	        code_spec = getattr(spec, "code_exec", None) if spec is not None else None
41	        return build_code_exec_scorer(code_spec)
42	    if spec_name in BUILTIN_SCORERS:
43	        return BUILTIN_SCORERS[spec_name]
44	    if ":" in spec_name:
45	        mod_name, _, func = spec_name.partition(":")
46	        if mod_name.endswith(".py"):
47	            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_aqa_scorer", mod_name)
48	            if spec and spec.loader:
49	                module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
50	                spec.loader.exec_module(module)
51	                return getattr(module, func)
52	        module = importlib.import_module(mod_name)
53	        return getattr(module, func)
54	    raise AqaError(f"unknown scorer {spec_name!r}")
55	
56	
57	class NativeHarness:
58	    name = "native"
59	
60	    def __init__(self, *, limit: int | None = None):
61	        self.limit = limit
62	
63	    def available(self) -> bool:
64	        return True
65	
66	    def evaluate_samples(
67	        self,
68	        recipe: BenchmarkRecipe,
69	        samples: list[dict[str, Any]],
70	        generate_fn: GenerateFn,
71	    ) -> BenchmarkResult:
72	        """Pure, testable core: score model outputs over ``samples``."""
73	        scorer_name = recipe.scoring.scorer or "exact_match"
74	        scorer = resolve_scorer(scorer_name, recipe.scoring)
75	        if not recipe.prompt or not recipe.target_field:
76	            raise AqaError(f"native recipe {recipe.name} needs `prompt` and `target_field`")
77	        total, correct = 0, 0.0
78	        per_sample: list[float] = []
79	        for sample in samples:
80	            prompt = render_prompt(recipe.prompt, sample)
81	            prediction = generate_fn(prompt)
82	            target = str(sample.get(recipe.target_field, ""))
83	            choices = sample.get("choices")
84	            result = scorer(ScorerInput(
85	                prediction=prediction, target=target, choices=choices,
86	                extra={"question": prompt, "prompt": prompt, "sample": sample},
87	            ))
88	            s = float(result.get("score", 0.0))
89	            per_sample.append(s)
90	            correct += s
91	            total += 1
92	        score = correct / total if total else 0.0
93	        return BenchmarkResult(
94	            name=recipe.name, score=score, metric=scorer_name, num_samples=total,
95	            per_sample=per_sample,
96	        )
97	
98	    def run(self, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe, model: str, backend, out_dir: Path) -> BenchmarkResult:
99	        if not recipe.dataset:
100	            raise AqaError(f"native recipe {recipe.name} needs a `dataset` URI")
101	        samples = list(load_samples(recipe.dataset, limit=self.limit))
102	        generate_fn = _build_hf_generate_fn(model, recipe)
103	        result = self.evaluate_samples(recipe, samples, generate_fn)
104	        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
105	        (out_dir / f"{recipe.name}.native.json").write_text(
106	            __import__("json").dumps(result.__dict__, indent=2, default=str)
107	        )
108	        return result
109	
110	
111	def _build_hf_generate_fn(model: str, recipe: BenchmarkRecipe) -> GenerateFn:
112	    """Construct a greedy HF-transformers generation function (needs torch)."""
113	    try:
114	        import torch
115	        from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
116	    except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - optional heavy dep
117	        raise AqaError(
118	            "native run needs transformers+torch: pip install autoquant-agent[hf]"
119	        ) from exc
120	
121	    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model, trust_remote_code=True)
122	    lm = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
123	        model, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="auto", trust_remote_code=True
124	    )
125	    max_new = int(recipe.gen_kwargs.get("max_gen_toks", 256))
126	
127	    def generate(prompt: str) -> str:
128	        inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(lm.device)
129	        with torch.no_grad():
130	            out = lm.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=max_new, do_sample=False)
131	        text = tokenizer.decode(out[0][inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]:], skip_special_tokens=True)
132	        return text
133	
134	    return generate

1	"""Inference backends: encapsulate how a model is loaded for evaluation.
2	
3	A backend maps to lm-eval's ``--model`` flag and builds the ``--model_args``
4	string, faithful to the historic ``local_dispatch`` ``build_model_args`` logic.
5	Adding a new infra (e.g. vllm_xpu) is a new class + entry-point registration.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	from typing import Any, Protocol, runtime_checkable
11	
12	
13	def _fmt(value: Any) -> str:
14	    """Render a value the way lm_eval's --model_args expects (bools => True/False)."""
15	    if isinstance(value, bool):
16	        return "True" if value else "False"
17	    return str(value)
18	
19	
20	def merge_model_args(base: list[str], extra: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
21	    """Merge ``key=value`` defaults with user ``extra`` (extra overrides), preserving order.
22	
23	    ``base`` is a list of ``"key=value"`` strings; ``extra`` is a dict whose keys
24	    replace matching base keys and whose new keys are appended.  Used so users can
25	    override or extend backend model_args from ``eval.lm_eval.model_args`` (e.g.
26	    ``enable_thinking=False``, ``reasoning_parser=qwen3``).
27	    """
28	    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
29	    seen: dict[str, int] = {}
30	    for item in base:
31	        key, _, val = item.partition("=")
32	        seen[key] = len(pairs)
33	        pairs.append((key, val))
34	    for key, value in (extra or {}).items():
35	        rendered = _fmt(value)
36	        if key in seen:
37	            pairs[seen[key]] = (key, rendered)
38	        else:
39	            seen[key] = len(pairs)
40	            pairs.append((key, rendered))
41	    return ",".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in pairs)

2	
3	This is the reference executor that lets the framework run on any machine that
4	can already reach the GPU (or inside a container), with no reservation system or
5	multi-hop SSH -- the open-source baseline path.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import json
11	from pathlib import Path
12	
13	from ..logging_util import get_logger
14	from ..pipeline import run_pipeline
15	from . import ProcessState, RunResult
16

18	_META = "aqa_run.json"
19	
20	
21	class LocalExecutor:
22	    name = "local"
23	
24	    def __init__(self, **options):
25	        self.options = options
26	
27	    def run(self, run_cfg, *, dry_run: bool = False, resume: bool = False) -> RunResult:
28	        out_dir = Path(run_cfg.output.dir)
29	        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
30	        meta_path = out_dir / _META
31	        meta_path.write_text(json.dumps({"model": run_cfg.model, "state": "running"}))

33	            _log.info("[dry-run] would run pipeline for %s in %s", run_cfg.model, out_dir)

35	        state = run_pipeline(run_cfg, out_dir)
36	        meta_path.write_text(json.dumps({"model": run_cfg.model, "state": state.value}))
37	        return RunResult(output_dir=out_dir, state=state)

39	    def status(self, output_dir: Path) -> ProcessState:
40	        meta = Path(output_dir) / _META
41	        if not meta.exists():
42	            return ProcessState.UNKNOWN
43	        return ProcessState(json.loads(meta.read_text()).get("state", "unknown"))
44	
45	    def stop(self, output_dir: Path) -> bool:
46	        return False  # in-process; nothing to signal
47	
48	    @staticmethod
49	    def detect(output_dir: Path) -> bool:
50	        return (Path(output_dir) / _META).exists()

1	"""Reporting helpers: aggregate an EvalResult (+ optional baseline) and gate."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	from dataclasses import dataclass
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	from ..config import GateConfig
10	from ..eval.registry import EvalResult
11	from .stats import compare_scores
12	
13	
14	@dataclass
15	class GateDecision:
16	    verdict: str  # GO | NO-GO | INCONCLUSIVE
17	    reasons: list[str]
18	
19	
20	def write_accuracy_json(result: EvalResult, out_dir: Path) -> Path:
21	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
22	    path = out_dir / "accuracy.json"
23	    path.write_text(json.dumps(result.to_dict(), indent=2))
24	    return path
25	
26	
27	def evaluate_gate(
28	    quantized: EvalResult, baseline: EvalResult | None, gate: GateConfig
29	) -> GateDecision:
30	    """GO/NO-GO decision comparing quantized vs baseline (NeMo `nel gate` style)."""
31	    reasons: list[str] = []
32	    verdict = "GO"
33	    if gate.min_accuracy is not None:
34	        mean = quantized.mean_score()
35	        if mean < gate.min_accuracy:
36	            verdict = "NO-GO"
37	            reasons.append(f"mean accuracy {mean:.4f} < min_accuracy {gate.min_accuracy}")
38	    if gate.max_accuracy_drop is not None:
39	        if baseline is None:
40	            return GateDecision("INCONCLUSIVE", ["max_accuracy_drop set but no baseline available"])
41	        for name, q in quantized.benchmarks.items():
42	            b = baseline.benchmarks.get(name)
43	            if b is None:
44	                continue
45	            drop = b.score - q.score
46	            if drop <= gate.max_accuracy_drop:
47	                continue
48	            # The drop exceeds the threshold. When significance testing is on, only
49	            # fail if the drop is also statistically significant -- a drop within
50	            # sampling noise is INCONCLUSIVE, not a hard NO-GO.
51	            if gate.significance:
52	                sig = compare_scores(
53	                    base_score=b.score, quant_score=q.score,
54	                    n=max(b.num_samples, q.num_samples),
55	                    base_correct=b.per_sample, quant_correct=q.per_sample,
56	                    alpha=gate.alpha,
57	                )
58	                if not sig.significant:
59	                    if verdict == "GO":
60	                        verdict = "INCONCLUSIVE"
61	                    reasons.append(
62	                        f"{name}: drop {drop:.4f} > {gate.max_accuracy_drop} but NOT "
63	                        f"significant (p={sig.p_value:.3g}, {sig.test}; {sig.detail})"
64	                    )
65	                    continue
66	                verdict = "NO-GO"
67	                reasons.append(
68	                    f"{name}: drop {drop:.4f} > {gate.max_accuracy_drop} and significant "
69	                    f"(p={sig.p_value:.3g}, {sig.test})"
70	                )
71	            else:
72	                verdict = "NO-GO"
73	                reasons.append(
74	                    f"{name}: drop {drop:.4f} > max_accuracy_drop {gate.max_accuracy_drop}"
75	                )
76	    if not reasons:
77	        reasons.append("all gate checks passed")
78	    return GateDecision(verdict, reasons)

1	"""Statistical significance tests for the quantization accuracy gate.
2	
3	Dependency-free (``math`` only) ports of the significance machinery from NeMo
4	Evaluator's ``metrics/paired_tests.py`` + ``confidence.py``.  The gate uses these
5	to decide whether a quantized model's accuracy *drop* is real signal or sampling
6	noise, instead of tripping on any drop above a fixed threshold.
7	
8	Two regimes:
9	  * **Paired** (per-sample correctness available for both models): McNemar's test
10	    (exact binomial for small discordant counts, chi-square with continuity
11	    correction otherwise) and a paired sign / permutation test.
12	  * **Unpaired** (only aggregate score + n): two-proportion z-test, and Wilson
13	    score confidence intervals per model.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import math
19	import random
20	from dataclasses import dataclass
21	
22	
23	def _phi(x: float) -> float:
24	    """Standard normal CDF."""
25	    return 0.5 * (1.0 + math.erf(x / math.sqrt(2.0)))
26	
27	
28	def _two_sided_normal_p(z: float) -> float:
29	    """Two-sided p-value for a z statistic."""
30	    return math.erfc(abs(z) / math.sqrt(2.0))
31	
32	
33	def _binom_two_sided_p(k: int, n: int, p: float = 0.5) -> float:
34	    """Exact two-sided binomial p-value for observing ``k`` of ``n`` (H0: prob ``p``)."""
35	    if n == 0:
36	        return 1.0
37	    from math import comb
38	
39	    def pmf(i: int) -> float:
40	        return comb(n, i) * (p ** i) * ((1 - p) ** (n - i))
41	
42	    observed = pmf(k)
43	    # Sum probabilities of outcomes at least as extreme (<= observed pmf), with a
44	    # small epsilon for float wobble -- the standard two-sided binomial construction.
45	    total = sum(pmf(i) for i in range(n + 1) if pmf(i) <= observed * (1 + 1e-9))
46	    return min(1.0, total)
47	
48	
49	def wilson_interval(k: int, n: int, z: float = 1.96) -> tuple[float, float]:
50	    """Wilson score confidence interval for a proportion ``k/n`` (default 95%)."""
51	    if n == 0:
52	        return (0.0, 1.0)
53	    phat = k / n
54	    denom = 1.0 + z * z / n
55	    center = (phat + z * z / (2 * n)) / denom
56	    half = (z * math.sqrt(phat * (1 - phat) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n))) / denom
57	    return (max(0.0, center - half), min(1.0, center + half))
58	
59	
60	def mcnemar_test(b: int, c: int) -> float:
61	    """McNemar's paired test p-value from discordant counts.
62	
63	    ``b`` = baseline-correct & quantized-wrong, ``c`` = baseline-wrong &
64	    quantized-correct.  Exact binomial when ``b + c`` is small; chi-square with
65	    continuity correction otherwise.
66	    """
67	    n = b + c
68	    if n == 0:
69	        return 1.0
70	    if n <= 25:
71	        return _binom_two_sided_p(min(b, c), n, 0.5)
72	    chi2 = (abs(b - c) - 1) ** 2 / n
73	    # Survival function of chi-square with 1 df == erfc(sqrt(chi2/2)).
74	    return math.erfc(math.sqrt(chi2 / 2.0))
75	
76	
77	def discordant_counts(base_correct: list[float], quant_correct: list[float]) -> tuple[int, int]:
78	    """Return ``(b, c)`` discordant pair counts from two 0/1 correctness vectors."""
79	    if len(base_correct) != len(quant_correct):
80	        raise ValueError("correctness vectors must be the same length")
81	    b = c = 0
82	    for bc, qc in zip(base_correct, quant_correct, strict=True):
83	        bb, qq = bc >= 0.5, qc >= 0.5
84	        if bb and not qq:
85	            b += 1
86	        elif not bb and qq:
87	            c += 1
88	    return b, c
89	
90	
91	def sign_test(diffs: list[float]) -> float:
92	    """Two-sided paired sign test p-value (ignoring exact-zero differences)."""
93	    pos = sum(1 for d in diffs if d > 0)
94	    neg = sum(1 for d in diffs if d < 0)
95	    n = pos + neg
96	    if n == 0:
97	        return 1.0
98	    return _binom_two_sided_p(min(pos, neg), n, 0.5)
99	
100	
101	def paired_permutation_test(
102	    base_scores: list[float], quant_scores: list[float], *,
103	    iterations: int = 10000, seed: int = 0,
104	) -> float:
105	    """Two-sided paired permutation test on per-sample score differences."""
106	    if len(base_scores) != len(quant_scores):
107	        raise ValueError("score vectors must be the same length")
108	    diffs = [q - b for b, q in zip(quant_scores, base_scores, strict=True)]
109	    n = len(diffs)
110	    if n == 0:
111	        return 1.0
112	    observed = abs(sum(diffs) / n)
113	    if observed == 0:
114	        return 1.0
115	    rng = random.Random(seed)
116	    at_least = 0
117	    for _ in range(iterations):
118	        s = sum(d if rng.random() < 0.5 else -d for d in diffs)
119	        if abs(s / n) >= observed - 1e-12:
120	            at_least += 1
121	    return (at_least + 1) / (iterations + 1)  # add-one smoothing
122	
123	
124	def two_proportion_ztest(k1: int, n1: int, k2: int, n2: int) -> float:
125	    """Two-sided two-proportion z-test p-value (unpaired fallback)."""
126	    if n1 == 0 or n2 == 0:
127	        return 1.0
128	    p1, p2 = k1 / n1, k2 / n2
129	    pool = (k1 + k2) / (n1 + n2)
130	    se = math.sqrt(pool * (1 - pool) * (1 / n1 + 1 / n2))
131	    if se == 0:
132	        return 1.0
133	    return _two_sided_normal_p((p1 - p2) / se)
134	
135	
136	@dataclass
137	class SignificanceResult:
138	    """Outcome of a paired/unpaired significance test between two models."""
139	
140	    test: str            # mcnemar | two_proportion | sign | permutation
141	    p_value: float
142	    significant: bool    # p_value < alpha
143	    effect: float        # baseline_score - quantized_score (positive => a drop)
144	    detail: str = ""
145	
146	
147	def compare_scores(
148	    *,
149	    base_score: float,
150	    quant_score: float,
151	    n: int,
152	    base_correct: list[float] | None = None,
153	    quant_correct: list[float] | None = None,
154	    alpha: float = 0.05,
155	) -> SignificanceResult:
156	    """Test whether quantized vs baseline differ significantly.
157	
158	    Uses McNemar's paired test when per-sample correctness vectors are supplied for
159	    both models; otherwise a two-proportion z-test on aggregate score * n.
160	    """
161	    effect = base_score - quant_score
162	    if base_correct is not None and quant_correct is not None:
163	        b, c = discordant_counts(base_correct, quant_correct)
164	        p = mcnemar_test(b, c)
165	        return SignificanceResult(
166	            test="mcnemar", p_value=p, significant=p < alpha, effect=effect,
167	            detail=f"discordant b={b} c={c}",
168	        )
169	    kb = round(base_score * n)
170	    kq = round(quant_score * n)
171	    p = two_proportion_ztest(kb, n, kq, n)
172	    return SignificanceResult(
173	        test="two_proportion", p_value=p, significant=p < alpha, effect=effect,
174	        detail=f"n={n} k_base={kb} k_quant={kq}",
175	    )

1	"""Stage a run directory for upload: exclude model weights / caches and scrub
2	secrets from text artifacts.
3	
4	Ported from ``local_dispatch/upload_results_hf_dataset.py`` so the aqa results
5	sink writes back the *same* shape local_dispatch did (logs, agent fix records,
6	patches, summaries), minus the quantized weights, with secrets redacted.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import os
12	import re
13	import shutil
14	from pathlib import Path
15	
16	# Suffixes we sanitize as UTF-8 text; everything else is copied byte-for-byte.
17	TEXT_SUFFIXES = {
18	    ".json", ".jsonl", ".log", ".md", ".txt", ".sh", ".py",
19	    ".yaml", ".yml", ".patch", ".diff", ".csv", ".cfg", ".ini",
20	}
21	
22	# Directories that must never be uploaded (weights + caches + vcs).
23	EXCLUDED_DIRS = {
24	    "quantized", "quantized_model", "__pycache__", ".git", ".cache",
25	    ".pytest_cache", ".venv", "venv",
26	}
27	
28	# Weight/blob files that may live outside a weights dir.
29	EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES = {
30	    ".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".gguf", ".onnx", ".h5", ".ckpt",
31	}
32	
33	SECRET_PATTERNS = (
34	    re.compile(r"hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"),
35	    re.compile(r"(?:ghp|github_pat)_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
36	    re.compile(r"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}"),
37	    re.compile(r"(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*bearer\s+)[^\s\"']+"),
38	    re.compile(r"(?i)(x-access-token:***REDACTED***@\s/]+"),
39	)
40	
41	
42	def sanitize_text(text: str) -> str:
43	    """Redact tokens/secrets from a text artifact before it leaves the machine."""
44	    for pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS:
45	        if pattern.groups:
46	            text = pattern.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + "***REDACTED***", text)
47	        else:
48	            text = pattern.sub("***REDACTED***", text)
49	    return text
50	
51	
52	def stage_run_artifacts(
53	    src: Path,
54	    dst: Path,
55	    *,
56	    extra_excluded_dirs: set[str] | None = None,
57	    sanitize: bool = True,
58	) -> list[str]:
59	    """Copy ``src`` into ``dst`` excluding weights/caches and scrubbing text.
60	
61	    Returns the list of copied paths (relative to ``src``).
62	    """
63	    src = Path(src)
64	    dst = Path(dst)
65	    excluded = set(EXCLUDED_DIRS)
66	    if extra_excluded_dirs:
67	        excluded |= set(extra_excluded_dirs)
68	    copied: list[str] = []
69	    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src):
70	        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in excluded]
71	        root_path = Path(root)
72	        rel_root = root_path.relative_to(src)
73	        for name in files:
74	            source = root_path / name
75	            if source.suffix.lower() in EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES:
76	                continue
77	            rel = rel_root / name
78	            target = dst / rel
79	            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
80	            if sanitize and source.suffix.lower() in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
81	                try:
82	                    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
83	                    target.write_text(sanitize_text(text), encoding="utf-8")
84	                except OSError:
85	                    continue
86	            else:
87	                try:
88	                    shutil.copy2(source, target)
89	                except OSError:
90	                    continue
91	            copied.append(str(rel))
92	    return copied

4	repo's own ``docker/gpu.dockerfile`` on an NGC base), and runs ``aqa run`` inside

109	def _split_host(host: str) -> tuple[str, str, int]:
110	    user = None

120	def _auth_kwargs(auth) -> dict:
121	    kw: dict = {"allow_agent": auth.method == "agent", "look_for_keys": auth.method == "agent"}
122	    if auth.method == "password":

124	            raise AqaError(f"ssh password auth requires env var {auth.password_env!r} to be set")
125	        kw["password"] = os.environ[auth.password_env]

131	def _connect(paramiko, *, host, port, user, auth, timeout, sock=None):
132	    """Connect a paramiko client, falling back to keyboard-interactive for
133	    password auth against servers that only offer that method (PAM)."""
134	    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
135	    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
136	    try:
137	        client.connect(hostname=host, port=port, username=user, timeout=timeout,
138	                       auth_timeout=timeout, banner_timeout=timeout, sock=sock,
139	                       **_auth_kwargs(auth))
140	        return client
141	    except paramiko.AuthenticationException:
142	        if auth.method != "password":
143	            raise
144	        # Retry over the raw transport with keyboard-interactive (same password).
145	        password = os.environ[auth.password_env]
146	        transport = client.get_transport()
147	        if transport is None or not transport.is_active():
148	            client.close()
149	            raise
150	        try:
151	            transport.auth_interactive_dumb(user, lambda *a, **k: [password])
152	        except Exception as exc:
153	            client.close()
154	            raise AqaError(
155	                f"ssh authentication failed for {user}@{host}: check the login user "
156	                f"and the value of ${auth.password_env}"

188	    cur = ""
189	    for part in path.strip("/").split("/"):
190	        cur = f"{cur}/{part}" if cur else (f"/{part}" if path.startswith("/") else part)

197	def _sftp_fetch_tree(
198	    sftp, remote_dir: str, local_dir: Path, *, max_bytes: int = 500 * 1024 * 1024
199	) -> int:
200	    """Recursively download ``remote_dir`` into ``local_dir``; return file count.
201	
202	    Skips weights/caches (the same set excluded from result uploads) so we never
203	    drag multi-GB ``.safetensors`` back over SFTP -- that both wastes bandwidth and
204	    can stall paramiko's prefetch indefinitely (the run's own hf_dataset sink is
205	    what publishes results; this fetch is only for local log/json inspection). A
206	    ``max_bytes`` backstop skips any unexpectedly large blob rather than hanging.
207	
208	    Silently returns 0 if the remote dir does not exist (e.g. run failed before
209	    producing any results).
210	    """
211	    import stat as _stat
212	
213	    from ..report.scrub import EXCLUDED_DIRS, EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES
214	
215	    try:
216	        entries = sftp.listdir_attr(remote_dir)
217	    except OSError:
218	        return 0
219	    count = 0
220	    local_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
221	    for entry in entries:
222	        rpath = f"{remote_dir}/{entry.filename}"
223	        lpath = local_dir / entry.filename
224	        if _stat.S_ISDIR(entry.st_mode):
225	            if entry.filename in EXCLUDED_DIRS:
226	                _log.info("skipping excluded dir %s", rpath)
227	                continue
228	            count += _sftp_fetch_tree(sftp, rpath, lpath, max_bytes=max_bytes)
229	        elif not _stat.S_ISREG(entry.st_mode):
230	            _log.info("skipping non-regular file %s", rpath)  # fifo/socket/device
231	        elif Path(entry.filename).suffix.lower() in EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES:
232	            _log.info("skipping weight/blob %s", rpath)
233	        elif entry.st_size is not None and entry.st_size > max_bytes:
234	            _log.warning("skipping oversized file %s (%d bytes)", rpath, entry.st_size)
235	        else:
236	            try:
237	                sftp.get(rpath, str(lpath))
238	                count += 1
239	            except OSError:
240	                _log.warning("could not fetch %s", rpath)
241	    return count

244	def _exec_stream(client, command: str, *, poll: float = 0.5) -> int:
245	    """Run ``command`` remotely, streaming combined stdout/stderr live; return rc.
246	
247	    lm_eval / vllm report progress with tqdm bars that use carriage returns
248	    (``\\r``) instead of newlines, and phases like model load or a long eval run
249	    for minutes emitting no ``\\n`` at all.  Splitting only on ``\\n`` therefore
250	    makes those phases look hung (while the GPU is clearly busy).  We instead:
251	
252	      * treat both ``\\r`` and ``\\n`` as line delimiters, so each progress update
253	        surfaces as it arrives, and
254	      * block on ``recv`` with a short timeout (no busy-poll) and, when the stream
255	        goes briefly idle, flush any pending partial line so a paused progress bar
256	        or newline-less prompt still shows up.
257	    """
258	    chan = client.get_transport().open_session()
259	    chan.get_pty()
260	    chan.exec_command(command)
261	    chan.settimeout(poll)
262	    buf = b""
263	    while True:
264	        try:
265	            data = chan.recv(65536)
266	        except TimeoutError:
267	            data = b""
268	        if data:
269	            buf += data
270	            parts = re.split(rb"[\r\n]", buf)
271	            buf = parts.pop()  # trailing partial line; completes on a later read
272	            for line in parts:
273	                if line:
274	                    _log.info("[remote] %s", line.decode(errors="replace"))
275	        else:
276	            if buf:
277	                _log.info("[remote] %s", buf.decode(errors="replace"))
278	                buf = b""
279	            if chan.exit_status_ready():
280	                break
281	    if buf:
282	        _log.info("[remote] %s", buf.decode(errors="replace"))
283	    return chan.recv_exit_status()

315	            return RunResult(output_dir=out_dir, state=ProcessState.DONE)
316	
317	        _log.info("[CMD] %s  (staging + docker build/run, run_id=%s)", printable, run_id)
318	        client = _open_client(ssh, timeout=int(self.options.get("timeout", 30)))
319	        try:
320	            sftp = client.open_sftp()
321	            root = self._expand(client, self.remote_root)
322	            work = f"{root}/{run_id}"
323	            _sftp_makedirs(sftp, work)
324	
325	            staged: dict[str, tuple[bytes, int]] = {
326	                "_repo.tgz": (_tar_repo(), 0o600),
327	                "_run.yaml": (inner_cfg.encode(), 0o600),
328	                "_bootstrap.sh": (build_container_bootstrap(run_cfg).encode(), 0o755),
329	                "_dispatch.sh": (script.encode(), 0o700),
330	            }
331	            if dockerfile is not None:
332	                staged["_gpu.dockerfile"] = (dockerfile, 0o600)
333	            if secrets:
334	                env_txt = "".join(f"{k}={v}\n" for k, v in secrets.items())
335	                staged["_secrets.env"] = (env_txt.encode(), 0o600)
336	
337	            for name, (content, mode) in staged.items():
338	                path = f"{work}/{name}"
339	                with sftp.open(path, "wb") as fh:
340	                    fh.write(content)
341	                sftp.chmod(path, mode)
342	
343	            rc = _exec_stream(client, f"bash {shlex.quote(work)}/_dispatch.sh")
344	
345	            # Pull the run's results/logs back so the user can inspect eval logs
346	            # (and gate/accuracy json) locally without SSHing into the box.
347	            remote_results = f"{work}/repo/results/{run_id}"
348	            out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
349	            fetched = _sftp_fetch_tree(sftp, remote_results, out_dir)
350	            if fetched:
351	                _log.info("fetched %d result file(s) into %s", fetched, out_dir)
352	            elif rc != 0:
353	                _log.warning("no result files found on remote at %s", remote_results)
354	            sftp.close()
355	        finally:
356	            client.close()
357	
358	        state = ProcessState.DONE if rc == 0 else ProcessState.FAILED
359	        if rc != 0:
360	            log_hint = next(iter(out_dir.rglob("*.eval.log")), None)
361	            _log.error("remote dispatch failed (rc=%s); remote run %s. %s",
362	                       rc, run_id,
363	                       f"see {log_hint}" if log_hint else f"inspect {out_dir}")
364	        return RunResult(output_dir=out_dir, state=state)

367	    def _expand(client, path: str) -> str:
368	        if not path.startswith("~"):
369	            return path
370	        _in, out, _err = client.exec_command(f"eval echo {shlex.quote(path)}")
371	        return out.read().decode().strip() or path

377	        return False

381	        return False

3	
4	The remote flow is intentionally self-contained -- it ships *this* package (not
5	an external repo), builds a docker image, and runs ``aqa run`` inside the
6	container with ``executor.type=local``.  There is no dependency on lb_eval.
7	"""

9	from __future__ import annotations

11	import os
12	import shlex
13	import time

15	from pathlib import Path

17	import yaml

19	from ..config import RunConfig
20	from ..logging_util import get_logger

24	DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE = "nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.01-py3"

33	# `--gpus '"device=<ids>"'`; Intel XPU passes /dev/dri through and selects cards
34	# with a Level-Zero affinity mask (re-indexed 0..N-1 inside the container).
35	_CUDA_DEVICE_ARGS = (
36	    '    --gpus \'"device=\'"$DEVICE_LIST"\'"\' \\\n'

45	    '    --shm-size=16g \\\n'
46	    '    --tty \\\n'
47	    '    -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \\\n'
48	    '    -e ZE_AFFINITY_MASK="$DEVICE_LIST" \\\n'
49	    '    -e VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn \\\n'

60	_SECRET_ALLOWLIST = (
61	    "HF_TOKEN",
62	    "HF_TOKENS",
63	    "HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN",
64	    "HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN",

73	def make_run_id(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> str:
74	    """Unique, filesystem-safe per-run id: ``<model>_<scheme>_<ts>_<rand>``."""
75	    scheme = run_cfg.quant.scheme if run_cfg.quant else "eval"
76	    base = f"{run_cfg.model.split('/')[-1]}_{scheme}"

81	def repo_root() -> Path:
82	    """Locate the installed source tree root (the dir holding ``pyproject.toml``)."""
83	    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
84	    for parent in here.parents:
85	        if (parent / "pyproject.toml").exists() and (parent / "aqa").is_dir():

91	def build_inner_config(run_cfg: RunConfig, run_id: str) -> str:
92	    """Serialize a derived run config for the in-container ``local`` run.
93	
94	    Strips the ssh/proxy executor wiring (that is the *host's* job) and repoints
95	    output at the mounted results dir.  Secrets are never embedded -- they arrive
96	    via the docker ``--env-file``.
97	    """
98	    data = run_cfg.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True)
99	    # The container is launched with `--gpus device=<ids>`; the in-container run
100	    # sees executor.type=local (no ssh block), so it would otherwise default to a
101	    # single GPU. Carry the host's device count through so the remote pipeline uses
102	    # the right vllm tensor_parallel_size and quantize --device_map.
103	    ssh_gpus = run_cfg.executor.ssh.gpus if run_cfg.executor.ssh else ""
104	    num_gpus = max(1, len([g for g in str(ssh_gpus).split(",") if g.strip()]))
105	    data["executor"] = {"type": "local", "num_gpus": num_gpus}
106	    data.setdefault("output", {})
107	    data["output"]["dir"] = f"{CONTAINER_RESULTS}/{run_id}"
108	    return yaml.safe_dump(data, sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
109	
110	
111	def collect_secret_env(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> dict[str, str]:
112	    """Gather env vars to forward into the container (secrets + sink tokens).
113	
114	    Sources: the standard allowlist (when set in the environment) plus any
115	    ``*_env`` keys referenced by output sinks (e.g. ``token_env``).
116	    """
117	    env: dict[str, str] = {}
118	    for name in _SECRET_ALLOWLIST:
119	        val = os.environ.get(name)
120	        if val:
121	            env[name] = val
122	    for sink in run_cfg.output.sinks:
123	        for key, value in sink.model_dump().items():
124	            if key.endswith("_env") and isinstance(value, str) and value:
125	                resolved = os.environ.get(value)
126	                if resolved:
127	                    env[value] = resolved
128	                    # Also expose as HF_TOKEN so huggingface_hub picks it up by default.
129	                    if "token" in key.lower():
130	                        env.setdefault("HF_TOKEN", resolved)
131	    return env
132

134	def _proxy_pairs(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
135	    proxy = run_cfg.executor.proxy
136	    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
137	    for var, val in (
138	        ("HTTP_PROXY", proxy.http_proxy),
139	        ("HTTPS_PROXY", proxy.https_proxy),
140	        ("NO_PROXY", proxy.no_proxy),
141	    ):
142	        if val:
143	            pairs.append((var, val))
144	            pairs.append((var.lower(), val))
145	    return pairs

148	def build_remote_script(
149	    run_cfg: RunConfig,
150	    run_id: str,
151	    *,
152	    has_secrets: bool,
153	    remote_root: str = "~/aqa-runs",
154	) -> str:
155	    """Bash executed on the remote host: extract -> docker build -> docker run aqa.
156	
157	    All per-run state lives under an isolated ``$ROOT/<run_id>`` directory so
158	    concurrent dispatches to the same machine never collide.  Only the HF cache
159	    and the docker image tag are shared.
160	    """
161	    gpus = run_cfg.executor.ssh.gpus if run_cfg.executor.ssh else "0"
162	    device_list = ",".join(g.strip() for g in str(gpus).split(",") if g.strip())
163	    accelerator = _accelerator(run_cfg)
164	    image = run_cfg.executor.image
165	    dockerfile = (image.dockerfile or "").strip()
166	    if accelerator == "xpu":
167	        base_image = (image.xpu or DEFAULT_XPU_BASE_IMAGE).strip()
168	        device_args = _XPU_DEVICE_ARGS
169	    else:
170	        base_image = (image.gpu or DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE).strip()
171	        device_args = _CUDA_DEVICE_ARGS
172	
173	    proxy_pairs = _proxy_pairs(run_cfg)
174	    proxy_shell = "".join(f'export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n' for k, v in proxy_pairs)
175	    build_proxy = "".join(f'    --build-arg {k}={shlex.quote(v)} \\\n' for k, v in proxy_pairs)
176	    run_proxy = "".join(f'    -e {k}={shlex.quote(v)} \\\n' for k, v in proxy_pairs)
177	    env_file_arg = '    --env-file "$WORK/_secrets.env" \\\n' if has_secrets else ""
178	
179	    tag = f"aqa-gpu:{'local' if dockerfile else 'base'}"
180	
181	    if not dockerfile:
182	        # No build: run the base image directly.
183	        build_section = (
184	            'IMAGE="' + base_image + '"\n'
185	            'echo "== [2/4] docker pull base image (no build) =="\n'
186	            '( set -x; docker pull "$IMAGE" ) || echo "[dispatch] pull failed; using local cache"\n'
187	        )
188	    else:
189	        # Build our shipped Dockerfile (or a custom one) from a clean context dir.
190	        build_section = (
191	            f'IMAGE="{tag}"\n'
192	            'mkdir -p "$WORK/_dockerctx"\n'
193	            'cp "$WORK/_gpu.dockerfile" "$WORK/_dockerctx/Dockerfile"\n'
194	            'echo "== [2/4] docker build (BASE_IMAGE=' + base_image + ') =="\n'
195	            'build_ok=0\n'
196	            'for i in 1 2 3; do\n'
197	            '    if ( set -x; docker build \\\n'
198	            f'{build_proxy}'
199	            f'        --build-arg BASE_IMAGE={shlex.quote(base_image)} \\\n'
200	            '        -f "$WORK/_dockerctx/Dockerfile" -t "$IMAGE" "$WORK/_dockerctx" ); then\n'
201	            '        build_ok=1; break\n'
202	            '    fi\n'
203	            '    echo "[dispatch] docker build attempt $i failed; retrying in 15s..." >&2; sleep 15\n'
204	            'done\n'
205	            '[ "$build_ok" = 1 ] || { echo "[dispatch] ERROR: docker build failed" >&2; exit 1; }\n'
206	        )
207	
208	    return f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
209	set -euo pipefail
210	
211	ROOT=$(eval echo "{remote_root}")
212	RUN_ID="{run_id}"
213	WORK="$ROOT/$RUN_ID"
214	REPO="$WORK/repo"
215	HF_CACHE_ABS=$(eval echo "~/.cache/huggingface")
216	DEVICE_LIST="{device_list}"
217	CONTAINER="aqa-{run_id}"
218	HOST_UID="$(id -u)"; HOST_GID="$(id -g)"
219	
220	{proxy_shell}mkdir -p "$WORK" "$REPO" "$HF_CACHE_ABS"
221	
222	echo "== [1/4] extract staged repo into $REPO =="
223	tar -xzf "$WORK/_repo.tgz" -C "$REPO"
224	
225	{build_section}
226	echo "== [3/4] stage run config + container bootstrap =="
227	cp "$WORK/_run.yaml" "$REPO/_run.yaml"
228	cp "$WORK/_bootstrap.sh" "$REPO/_bootstrap.sh"
229	chmod +x "$REPO/_bootstrap.sh"
230	
231	echo "== [4/4] docker run: pip install aqa + aqa run (GPUs device=$DEVICE_LIST) =="
232	trap 'rm -f "$WORK/_secrets.env"' EXIT
233	docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
234	rc=0
235	( set -x
236	docker run --rm --name "$CONTAINER" \\
237	{device_args}{env_file_arg}{run_proxy}    -v "$REPO":{CONTAINER_REPO} \\
238	    -v "$HF_CACHE_ABS":{CONTAINER_HF_CACHE} \\
239	    --entrypoint bash \\
240	    "$IMAGE" \\
241	    {CONTAINER_REPO}/_bootstrap.sh
242	) || rc=$?
243	
244	# Container runs as root over the bind mount; restore ownership for the SSH user.
245	docker run --rm -v "$WORK":/work --entrypoint sh ubuntu:24.04 \\
246	    -c "chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /work" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
247	
248	echo "[dispatch] run $RUN_ID finished rc=$rc; results under $REPO/results/$RUN_ID"
249	exit $rc
250	"""
251

253	def _accelerator(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> str:
254	    """Accelerator family of the dispatch target ("cuda" or "xpu")."""
255	    return run_cfg.executor.ssh.accelerator if run_cfg.executor.ssh else "cuda"

258	def container_packages(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> list[str]:
259	    """Compute the pip package list installed inside the container.
260	
261	    Base stack = auto-round + lm-eval; vllm is added when the eval backend needs
262	    it -- *except* on XPU, where the base image already ships a matching
263	    vllm-xpu build (installing CUDA ``vllm`` would clobber it).  User extras from
264	    ``executor.image.pip_install`` are appended (and can pin versions).
265	    """
266	    pkgs: list[str] = []
267	    if run_cfg.eval.backend == "vllm_omni":
268	        # Diffusion text-to-image stack: engine + pipeline utils + CLIP scorer deps.
269	        pkgs += [
270	            "vllm-omni", "diffusers", "datasets", "transformers",
271	            "sentencepiece", "accelerate", "pillow",
272	        ]
273	    elif run_cfg.eval.backend in ("vllm", "vllm_xpu") and _accelerator(run_cfg) != "xpu":
274	        pkgs.append("vllm")
275	    pkgs += ["auto-round", "lm-eval"]
276	    for extra in run_cfg.executor.image.pip_install:
277	        if extra and extra not in pkgs:
278	            pkgs.append(extra)
279	    return pkgs
280	
281	
282	def _agent_enabled(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> bool:
283	    agent = run_cfg.agent
284	    return bool(agent and (agent.fix_loop or agent.optimize))
285	
286	
287	def _wants_copilot_cli(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> bool:
288	    """True when the agent stack may invoke the ``copilot`` CLI on the remote host.
289	
290	    The fix-loop / optimize agent only needs the Copilot CLI when at least one
291	    configured tier resolves to the ``copilot`` backend (opus/sonnet/minimax/…).
292	    """
293	    if not _agent_enabled(run_cfg):
294	        return False
295	    from ..agent.tiers import resolve_tiers
296	
297	    return any(t.backend == "copilot" for t in resolve_tiers(run_cfg.agent.tiers))
298	
299	
300	def _agent_provision_snippet(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> str:
301	    """Install + provision the agent-fix backends (OpenClaw + optional Copilot).
302	
303	    Parity with ``local_dispatch/remote_exec.py``: OpenClaw is the default tier-0
304	    backend and is always installed; the Copilot CLI is added only when a
305	    copilot-backed tier is configured.  Node.js is baked into the ``local`` GPU
306	    image but absent from a plain base image (e.g. the vLLM XPU image), so it is
307	    installed at runtime when missing.  Config for both backends is laid down by
308	    ``aqa.agent.provision`` (syncs ``MINIMAX_API_KEY``, shares the project skills).
309	    """
310	    if not _agent_enabled(run_cfg):
311	        return ""
312	    copilot_install = ""
313	    if _wants_copilot_cli(run_cfg):
314	        copilot_install = (
315	            '    command -v copilot >/dev/null 2>&1 \\\n'
316	            "        || npm install -g @github/copilot >/dev/null 2>&1 \\\n"
317	            '        || echo "[bootstrap] WARN: copilot CLI install failed; '
318	            'copilot tiers disabled" >&2\n'
319	        )
320	    return f"""
321	echo "== container: provision agent-fix backends =="
322	if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
323	    echo "== container: install Node.js {NODE_VERSION} (agent CLIs) =="
324	    curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/{NODE_VERSION}/node-{NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz \\
325	        | tar -xJ --strip-components=1 -C /usr/local 2>/dev/null \\
326	        || echo "[bootstrap] WARN: node install failed; agent fix-loop tiers disabled" >&2
327	fi
328	if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
329	    command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1 \\
330	        || npm install -g openclaw@{OPENCLAW_VERSION} >/dev/null 2>&1 \\
331	        || echo "[bootstrap] WARN: openclaw install failed" >&2
332	{copilot_install}    python -m aqa.agent.provision --minimax-env MINIMAX_API_KEY --skills-dir {CONTAINER_REPO}/skills \\
333	        || echo "[bootstrap] WARN: agent config provisioning failed" >&2
334	else
335	    echo "[bootstrap] WARN: node/npm unavailable; agent fix-loop tiers will be skipped." >&2
336	fi
337	"""
338	
339	
340	def build_container_bootstrap(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> str:
341	    """Bash run inside the container: install aqa + stack, then ``aqa run`` local.
342	
343	    PEP-668 ("externally managed") is handled with ``--break-system-packages`` so
344	    installs land in the NGC base env instead of failing under uv --system.  The
345	    stack install is non-fatal (the agent fix-loop is meant to reconcile env
346	    drift), but the aqa install itself must succeed.  Versions are printed for
347	    debuggability.  When the agent fix-loop is enabled, the OpenClaw (+ optional
348	    Copilot) backends are installed and provisioned so the fix-loop can run on the
349	    remote host.
350	    """
351	    pkgs = " ".join(shlex.quote(p) for p in container_packages(run_cfg))
352	    agent_step = _agent_provision_snippet(run_cfg)
353	    return f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
354	set -uo pipefail
355	cd {CONTAINER_REPO}
356	
357	export PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1 PIP_ROOT_USER_ACTION=ignore PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
358	
359	echo "== container: install aqa (editable) =="
360	if ! pip install -e . ; then
361	    echo "[bootstrap] FATAL: failed to install aqa" >&2
362	    exit 1
363	fi
364	
365	echo "== container: install quant/eval stack: {pkgs} =="
366	pip install {pkgs} \\
367	    || echo "[bootstrap] WARN: stack install had errors; continuing (agent-fix may repair env)"
368	{agent_step}
369	echo "== container: environment =="
370	python -c "import torch; print('torch', torch.__version__, 'cuda', torch.version.cuda, 'gpus', torch.cuda.device_count())" || true
371	python -c "import vllm; print('vllm', vllm.__version__)" 2>/dev/null || echo "vllm: not importable"
372	
373	echo "== container: aqa run (executor.type=local) =="
374	exec aqa run {CONTAINER_REPO}/_run.yaml
375	"""
376	
377	
378	# Backwards-compatible constant (HF-only stack); prefer build_container_bootstrap().
379	CONTAINER_BOOTSTRAP = f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
380	set -uo pipefail
381	cd {CONTAINER_REPO}
382	export PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES=1 PIP_ROOT_USER_ACTION=ignore
383	pip install -e . || exit 1
384	pip install auto-round lm-eval || true
385	exec aqa run {CONTAINER_REPO}/_run.yaml
386	"""

1	"""Shared, persistent fix-knowledge store: lessons + replayable patches.
2	
3	The generic fix-loop learns from every run -- but only if what it learns *outlives*
4	the run. This store keeps lessons and successful patches in a location that is
5	shared across runs, models and machines, keyed by the error **signature** (not the
6	model), so a fix discovered once can be replayed deterministically the next time
7	the same failure appears -- with no agent call at all.
8	
9	Backends:
10	  * **Local** (always): a directory (default ``~/.cache/aqa/knowledge``) shared by
11	    every run on the host.
12	  * **Hugging Face dataset** (when ``repo`` is set): synced *down* into the local
13	    dir at run start and pushed *up* after a successful fix, giving cross-machine
14	    sharing across ephemeral remote containers.
15	
16	Layout (mirrored locally and in ``<repo>/<path_in_repo>/``)::
17	
18	    lessons/<phase>.jsonl                      # dedup-by-signature lessons
19	    patches/<phase>/<sig_hash>/
20	        <label>.patch  ...                     # per-area unified diffs
21	        meta.json                              # signature/error_class/model/scheme/ts
22	
23	Everything is best-effort: a missing repo/token, offline host or dirty patch is a
24	normal miss, never a hard failure -- the caller just falls back to the agent.
25	"""
26	
27	from __future__ import annotations
28	
29	import hashlib
30	import json
31	import shutil
32	import time
33	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
34	from pathlib import Path
35	
36	from ..logging_util import get_logger
37	from ..report.sinks import resolve_hf_token
38	from .drift import classify_error, exception_type
39	from .lessons import LessonStore, extract_signature
40	from .trajectories import TrajectoryStore, TrajectorySummary
41

56	def signature_hash(signature: str) -> str:
57	    """Stable short id for an error signature (patch-archive directory name)."""
58	    return hashlib.sha1(signature.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:16]

61	@dataclass
62	class PatchRecord:
63	    """A recorded, replayable fix keyed by an error signature."""
64	
65	    phase: str
66	    sig_hash: str
67	    signature: str
68	    error_class: str
69	    patch_files: dict[str, Path]  # label -> per-area .patch path (no "combined")
70	    exc_type: str = ""            # exact exception class name (structured key)
71	    model_id: str = ""
72	    scheme: str = ""
73	    method: str = ""
74	    ts: str = ""
75	
76	    def diff_text(self, max_chars: int = 4000) -> str:
77	        """Concatenated unified-diff text of this record's per-area patches.
78	
79	        Used to hand the recorded fix to the agent as *reference* (Option A): the
80	        patch is never auto-applied, so the agent reads these diffs and decides
81	        whether the mechanism applies to the current model/checkpoint. Large diffs
82	        are summarised + pointed-to instead of inlined (see :meth:`stat_summary` /
83	        :meth:`patch_paths`) so a multi-file source patch never bloats the prompt
84	        or, worse, gets hard-truncated mid-hunk.
85	        """
86	        chunks: list[str] = []
87	        for label, path in sorted(self.patch_files.items()):
88	            try:
89	                body = Path(path).read_text()
90	            except OSError:
91	                continue
92	            if body.strip():
93	                chunks.append(f"# area: {label}\n{body.rstrip()}")
94	        text = "\n".join(chunks)
95	        if len(text) > max_chars:
96	            text = text[:max_chars] + "\n... [truncated]"
97	        return text
98	
99	    def stat_summary(self) -> str:
100	        """Compact 'N files [paths], +A/-D lines' description of this record's diff."""
101	        files: list[str] = []
102	        adds = dels = 0
103	        for line in self.diff_text(max_chars=200_000).splitlines():
104	            if line.startswith("+++ "):
105	                files.append(line[4:].strip())
106	            elif line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
107	                adds += 1
108	            elif line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
109	                dels += 1
110	        flist = ", ".join(files) if files else "?"
111	        return f"touches {len(files)} file(s) [{flist}], +{adds}/-{dels} lines"
112	
113	    def patch_paths(self) -> list[str]:
114	        """On-disk paths of the per-area .patch files (for on-demand agent reading)."""
115	        return [str(self.patch_files[k]) for k in sorted(self.patch_files)]

118	class KnowledgeStore:
119	    """Local (optionally HF-dataset-backed) shared lessons + patch archive."""

121	    local_dir: Path
122	    repo: str | None = None
123	    path_in_repo: str = "knowledge"
124	    token_env: str | None = None

130	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
131	        self.local_dir = Path(self.local_dir).expanduser()
132	        (self.local_dir / "lessons").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
133	        (self.local_dir / "patches").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

138	    @classmethod
139	    def from_config(cls, cfg) -> KnowledgeStore | None:
140	        """Build a store from a ``KnowledgeConfig`` (returns None when disabled)."""
141	        if not getattr(cfg, "enabled", True):
142	            return None
143	        local = Path(cfg.local_dir).expanduser() if cfg.local_dir else default_local_dir()
144	        return cls(
145	            local_dir=local,
146	            repo=cfg.repo,
